stories.title: Yemeni forces claim key heights as Houthi attacks go on
stories.summary: Yemeni government forces say they have seized strategic high ground while Houthi attacks continue, per Al Jazeera's rolling coverage. The fighting is part of a broader widening of Middle East conflict that has also disrupted Red Sea and Gulf shipping.

stories.title: LeBron James loses on his Philadelphia 76ers debut
stories.summary: LeBron James said it is 'going to take some time' for his new team-mates to gel after he suffered defeat in his first appearance for the Philadelphia 76ers in a pre-season game. The debut caps one of the biggest player moves of the NBA offseason.

stories.title: Ethiopia tells UN it must defend itself against Eritrea's 'all-out invasion'
stories.summary: Ethiopia's government told the UN Security Council it has 'no choice but to defend itself against an all-out invasion' by Eritrean forces, saying troops advanced as far as 60km into northern Tigray. The letter, shared with Reuters on Friday, marks a sharp escalation in the Horn of Africa conflict.

stories.title: Will Ethiopia's neighbours be drawn into the Tigray war?
stories.summary: Al Jazeera examines whether regional powers will intervene as fighting escalates, noting Ethiopia closed its embassy in Eritrea and expelled Eritrean diplomats on October 1. Ethiopia has accused Asmara of backing hostile acts in the renewed conflict.

stories.title: Apple cuts iPhone 18 Pro component orders on soft demand
stories.summary: Apple has slashed October component orders for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max by at least 15% versus its original plans after demand came in below expectations, Nikkei Asia reported. Higher prices and rising memory costs are being blamed for the slowdown.

stories.title: Monolithos launches long-term memory system for robots
stories.summary: Monolithos released a public alpha of Robot Brain, a long-term memory and experience service that lets robots and embodied AI systems retain tasks, failures and human corrections across sessions. It is pitched as a drop-in memory layer that does not replace existing planning or control stacks.

stories.title: SoftBank seeks up to $100B from Gulf investors for AI buyouts
stories.summary: SoftBank is seeking to raise as much as $100 billion from Gulf investors for a fund that would buy companies and improve them with AI and other advanced technology, according to the Financial Times. Founder Masayoshi Son has held talks with senior UAE figures in recent weeks.

stories.title: Anthropic offers free AI security scans to open-source maintainers
stories.summary: Anthropic launched OSS Scanner, a free service that uses its strongest models to hunt for vulnerabilities in open-source software and sends findings straight to maintainers without human review. Anthropic says human validation had become a bottleneck in its vulnerability research.

stories.title: Browns carry three-game winning streak into Jets matchup
stories.summary: Cleveland has been getting just enough offense while its defense keeps delivering, and rolls into Sunday's game at the New York Jets on a three-game winning streak. The October 9 notes roundup also covers the fall-out from the Week 4 win over Pittsburgh.

stories.title: Ryan Day ramps up urgency as No. 5 Ohio State faces Maryland
stories.summary: Ryan Day is pressing urgency as the fifth-ranked Buckeyes prepare to host Maryland before a demanding stretch of the schedule. Maryland arrives at 2-3 and 0-2 in the Big Ten on a three-game skid, with speculation growing about coach Mike Locksley's future.

stories.title: Norris confident McLaren has made progress for Singapore
stories.summary: Lando Norris says McLaren has worked on the MCL40's straight-line speed weakness ahead of the Singapore Grand Prix, but admits the real progress will only show once the car hits the track. McLaren has been hit by technical problems and inconsistent pace through 2026.

stories.title: FIA confirms Russell's power-unit change and back-of-grid start
stories.summary: The FIA confirmed Mercedes fitted George Russell's W17 with seven new power-unit components for Singapore, consigning him to the back of the grid at Marina Bay. Russell trails team-mate and championship leader Kimi Antonelli by 84 points with five rounds left.

stories.title: Singapore GP FP1: Russell fastest as pecking order stays unclear
stories.summary: George Russell topped the only practice session at Marina Bay ahead of Charles Leclerc and Lando Norris, with Max Verstappen sixth after radio trouble cost him running. Singapore runs the Sprint format for the first time this weekend.

stories.title: FIA reveals cause of Singapore's Sepang software glitch
stories.summary: The FIA concluded the Sepang formation-lap power losses came from cars running low engine RPM in sectors where a 250kW power reduction was applied. The regulator will reinstate the Sepang configuration in Singapore if rain threatens and ship another wet-weather software update for the US Grand Prix.

stories.title: New Escape from Tarkov client build pushed for October 9
stories.summary: A fresh Escape from Tarkov build (25822791) was logged for October 9, 2026, indicating Battlestate Games shipped another client update. No detailed patch notes accompanied the build.

stories.title: Players report Escape From Tarkov outages on October 9
stories.summary: Reports of Escape From Tarkov problems spiked around 3:08 a.m. ET on October 9, according to DownDetector data, with players flagging connectivity issues. No official cause had been posted by Battlestate Games.

stories.title: Scrubs & Beyond closing all stores, including two in Columbus
stories.summary: Healthcare-apparel retailer Scrubs & Beyond is shutting all of its locations nationwide, including two in central Ohio, though it has not announced a timeline. Both Columbus-area stores were still open as of Wednesday.

stories.title: Advocates warn Ohio school funding is being 'actively undercut'
stories.summary: Parents, educators and policy experts argued Ohio's school funding shortfall is the result of state legislative choices rather than local mismanagement, as districts prepare to ask voters for levies next month. The panel discussion was highlighted in the Ohio Capital Journal's October 9 roundup.
